test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 30 students in a class is 60 kg. If the weight of the class teacher is included, the average increases by 0.5 kg. The weight (in kg) of the teacher is:
solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 30 students = 60 kg

The average increase if the class teacher joined = 0.5 kg

**Formula used:**

Average={The sum of all the itemsover The total number of items}

**Calculation:**

Let the weight of the teacher be X kg

The sum of the weight of the students = 30 × 60 = 1800

The sum of students and teacher weight = 1800 + X

According to the question

The new average weight = 60 + 0.5 = 60.5

⇒ 60.5 = {1800+Xover31}

⇒ 60.5 × 31 = 1800 + X

⇒ 1875.5 = 1800 + X

⇒ 1875.5 - 1800 = X

⇒ X = 75.5

The weight of the teacher = 75.5 kg

**∴ The required result will be 75.5 kg.**
